tension: breadth-01 measured pairwise agreement of 0.429 across three local evaluator families with zero observed ship/no-ship flips on eight diffs, so evaluator disagreement was real but its decision relevance was not demonstrated. The practice it describes -- routing diffs through whichever reviewer model is cheapest -- is widespread and unmeasured. Knowing whether disagreement ever changes a decision determines whether evaluator choice deserves a benchmark at all, and eight diffs cannot answer it either way.
